textContent.text: Skunk sees an egg in the grass. It fell from its nest.
"I must help get it back," says Skunk.
He sets the egg in his bag. But he slips over a bump. The egg drops in the grass. It rolls, but Skunk is fast. He grabs the egg!
"Got it!" says Skunk.
He checks the egg. The egg is still good. Then Skunk spots the nest. He runs to it. And sets the egg in.
"Oh! Thank you!" the mom tells Skunk.

textContent.text: Chimp and Crab sit on the sand. "We must think of a plan. It is too hot here," says Crab.
"Let's make a raft!" says Chimp.
He gets six big sticks and bends them. Crab tugs at a clump of plants. She twists them with the sticks.
Crab and Chimp sit on the raft.
Crab puts cloth on top. "It will block the sun and help us go!" yells Crab.
Crab and Chimp cling to the raft. The wind picks up. They are off!
"Here we go!" says Chimp.

textContent.text: Fran and Tim are at the pond. They want to fish.
Tim slips in the mud. Plop! Fran yells, "Did you just fall?"
Tim nods. "But it is fun!" He flops in the mud.
"Tim! The fish will swim away," Fran says.
"Uh oh," Tim says. He grabs Fran's hand. Tim gets up and rubs off the mud.
Now they sit to fish. The rod dips. A fish tugs.
They yell, "We got one!"

A wig, a mask, and bug wings!

Pat puts on the mask and wings. "Buzz! I am a bug!" Pat says. She jumps and flaps.
Jill claps. "Dress up is the best!"

textContent.text: Kim and Nell camp by a rock. Kim gets the grill. Nell gets snacks.
"Can I get a bun?" Kim says.
Nell grabs the bag of buns. But he spots ants in the bag! "Yuck!" Nell yells. The ants zip off with a bun!
Then, a fox gets a hot dog off the grill.
"Quick! Grab a hot dog!" says Kim.
"Get a bun fast! The ants will get it all!" says Nell. Kim and Nell grab a bun and a hot dog.

"Want to go to the park?" she asked.

Mom suddenly smiled. "Wait here," she said.
She returned holding a box of colorful paper and some pens. "When I miss my faraway friends, I write them letters."
Rohan sat up tall and took a sheet and a pen.
Eagerly, he wrote to Noah about his fish and art prize. With each word, his smile grew wider.

Ember shook his head. "Bats love to scare dragons in the dark!" he cried. "I won't feel safe."
"You know what?" said the lightning bugs. "Bats hate bright lights! I think we can help."
The lightning bugs fluttered into Ember's cave and filled it with a warm glow. The bats flew out right away!
When the last bat disappeared into the darkness, Ember tiptoed inside his cave. He found his cozy corner and sighed.
"Now this feels safe," he said, curling up to sleep.
